title: Greygravel
body:
Extra info about Greygravel

Greygravel usually spawns in the Radical Shack section of Beach.

Greygravel automatically changes its name to "Gravel" when refined. It has a dark-grey texture that smoothens out and slightly lightens with refinement but darkens and becomes more pigmented with forging.

Pls help.

I gotchu bro

This material is currently obtainable and spawns often in the Radical Shack section of Beach, which is located near Alan's logistics and can be found quickly as shown in this map.
